<includeonly>{{SWArchive|url=collecting/news/misc/news20050512.html|text=Collectible Figurines with New DeAgostini Publication}} states that the original Spanish run of ''[[Star Wars: The Official Figurine Collection]]'' began in [[February]] [[2005]], released new issues every two weeks, and released its ninth issue at least one week after [[May 12]]. For issue #1 to have been released in February and issue #9 to be released less than two weeks after May 12, the first issue must have been released on [[February 1]].
